name: Compound
purpose: One market per base asset (e.g. USDC): lenders earn interest on the base asset, borrowers post collateral assets that earn nothing, underwater accounts are absorbed by the protocol.
about: Each Comet is a single market with one borrowable base asset and a fixed list of collateral assets. A user's base balance is one signed principal: positive is supply, negative is borrow; two indexes (supply and borrow) turn principal into present value and move on every accrual. Collateral is only collateral: it can't be borrowed and earns no interest. Liquidation has two steps: anyone calls absorb on an underwater account and the protocol takes its collateral and its debt onto its reserves; later anyone can buyCollateral from the protocol at a discount while reserves are below target. Parameters live in the Configurator; a change means deploying a new Comet implementation through the factory and upgrading the market's proxy through CometProxyAdmin. Main branch, no release tag: the commit is pinned.

contracts.name: CometWithExtendedAssetList
contracts.summary: Comet for one base asset: supply, withdraw (a withdraw past zero is a borrow), transfer, absorb, buyCollateral, accrue. Storage, configuration and maths come from CometCore, CometStorage and CometConfiguration; less used functions live in the extension (CometExt) reached through the fallback.

contracts.name: CometExtAssetList
contracts.summary: Second half of the market, run by DELEGATECALL from Comet's fallback on Comet's storage: allowances and permit-style allow, ERC-20 views (name, symbol, totalSupply, balanceOf) and other helpers.

contracts.name: AssetList
contracts.summary: Holds the market's collateral assets (price feed, scale, borrow and liquidate collateral factors, liquidation factor, supply cap) as immutables; the market reads them with getAssetInfo.

contracts.name: AssetListFactory
contracts.summary: Deploys an AssetList for a new market implementation.

contracts.name: Configurator
contracts.summary: Stores each market's next configuration. The governor sets parameters (rates, collateral, caps, factors); deploy builds a new implementation from them through the factory.

contracts.name: CometFactoryWithExtendedAssetList
contracts.summary: clone(config) deploys a new CometWithExtendedAssetList with the configuration baked in as immutables.

contracts.name: CometProxyAdmin
contracts.summary: Admin of each market's proxy. deployAndUpgradeTo asks the Configurator to deploy a new implementation and points the proxy to it; owner (governance) or a market admin.

contracts.name: CometRewards
contracts.summary: Pays reward tokens from the tracking indexes Comet keeps per account (baseTrackingAccrued).

externals.name: IERC20NonStandard
externals.label: Base and collateral tokens
externals.summary: The base asset and every collateral asset; transfers handle tokens that return nothing.

externals.name: IPriceFeed
externals.label: Price feeds
externals.summary: Chainlink-style feeds (latestRoundData) for the base asset and each collateral, set per asset in the configuration.

flows.title: Supply base
flows.summary: Supply the base asset (say USDC) and earn interest; a negative balance is repaid first.

steps.say: Approves the market, calls supply(baseToken, amount) (or supplyTo / supplyFrom with an operator's permission).
Entry point; all three variants go to supplyInternal.
Supply not paused; the operator must have permission from the source. Base asset goes to supplyBase, anything else to supplyCollateral.
The amount is pulled first (doTransferIn) and the balance difference is what counts.
Moves the supply and borrow indexes forward for the time elapsed, and the reward tracking indexes.
The signed principal goes up: debt is repaid first, the rest becomes supply. Totals updated.
Emits Supply, and Transfer(0, dst) for the part that became supply.

checks: Present value = principal × index; review rounding in presentValue / principalValue both ways.
Supply of base is also the repay path; integrations must not treat supply as always creating a positive balance.
Operators: hasPermission lets an allowed manager act for an account across supply, withdraw and transfer.

flows.title: Borrow
flows.summary: Supply collateral, then withdraw base past zero: that is the loan.

steps.say: First supply(collateralAsset, amount).
Pulls the collateral, checks the asset's supply cap, records it and marks the asset in the account's assetsIn bitmap. Collateral earns no interest.
Then withdraw(baseToken, amount).
Accrues, lowers the principal; below zero is a borrow.
For a negative balance: the debt must be at least baseBorrowMin and covered by Σ collateral × price × borrowCollateralFactor.
Prices for the base asset and each collateral in the account.
The base asset goes to the borrower.
Emits Withdraw.

checks: Two collateral factors per asset: borrow (to open debt) and liquidate (to be absorbed); review the gap between them.
Each price feed is per asset and fixed in the implementation; review heartbeat, decimals and what getPrice does with a non-positive answer.
baseBorrowMin stops dust loans; integrations must not try to borrow less.

flows.title: Absorb (liquidation)
flows.summary: The protocol takes over an underwater account: its collateral and its debt move onto the protocol's reserves.

steps.say: Anyone calls absorb(absorber, accounts).
Accrues once, then absorbs each account.
One account at a time.
Only a negative balance, and debt larger than Σ collateral × price × liquidateCollateralFactor.
Prices for the base asset and every collateral the account holds.
Every collateral asset is seized into the protocol (out of the account, kept by the market), valued with the liquidationFactor.
The account's debt is cleared against that value; any surplus becomes supply for the account. The protocol's reserves pay what is left.

checks: Absorb moves losses onto reserves: review reserves as the protocol's buffer and what happens when they go negative.
The absorber gets no collateral here, only tracked points (accrued gas usage); there is no direct liquidation bonus to integrate against.
Review that every collateral the account holds is seized and that assetsIn is cleared.

flows.title: Buy collateral
flows.summary: Buy absorbed collateral from the protocol at a discount, while reserves are below target.

steps.say: Approves the base asset, calls buyCollateral(asset, minAmount, baseAmount, recipient).
Not paused, and reserves below targetReserves; otherwise NotForSale.
The base asset is pulled first.
Collateral for that base amount at the feed price minus the store front discount (storeFrontPriceFactor × (1 − liquidationFactor)).
At least minAmount, and no more than the collateral the protocol holds.
The collateral goes to the recipient. Emits BuyCollateral.

checks: minAmount is the buyer's slippage protection.
The discount depends on configured factors; review them per asset.
Collateral reserves are the market's balance minus users' collateral; review that accounting never counts user collateral as for sale.

flows.title: Change a parameter
flows.summary: Parameters are immutables: a change deploys a new implementation and upgrades the proxy.

steps.say: Through governance, calls a Configurator setter (for example setBorrowKink, updateAssetSupplyCap).
Setters only change the stored next configuration for that market; nothing on the live market changes yet.
Owner or market admin: asks the Configurator for a new implementation and upgrades the proxy to it.
Builds the implementation from the stored configuration through the market's factory.
Deploys a new CometWithExtendedAssetList; every parameter becomes an immutable in its bytecode.

checks: Every parameter change is an implementation upgrade: review storage compatibility and that the new configuration matches what was voted.
Who is owner of CometProxyAdmin and who may act as market admin (MarketAdminPermissionChecker).
The pause guardian can pause supply, transfer, withdraw, absorb and buy separately.
Signed principal and two indexes: rounding of present and principal value both ways.
Price feeds per asset and getPrice's handling of bad answers.
Reserves: absorb draws on them, buyCollateral refills them; target reserves gate sales.
Upgrades: parameters are immutables, so every change is a new implementation behind the proxy.
notes: Mapped: the extended-asset-list Comet market (the current main branch), its extension, collateral list, configurator, factory, proxy admin and rewards. Not mapped: bulkers, bridges and receivers, liquidator bots, market update proposers, older Comet without extended asset list. The repository has no release tags; the commit is pinned.
